actions.title: Fill the repository administrator seat and record branch protection on main
actions.acceptance: HALF DONE: the seat is held by BizEra through BOOTSTRAP-001 (DEC-036), so the criterion that a named human holds the seat in badf/agents.yaml is met on the record; review finding B6 (issue 8) contests that seating and is open. REMAINING: the first-fill verification of that seating by a different human seat (B6, decision D2), and the administrator's record of the protection. main is protected with the CI jobs required, force-push and deletion blocked, and one independent approval per merge, and badf/authority.yaml main_branch_protection and badf/current-state.json record it (both still read NOT_RECORDED). Negative control 6 of the P0.2 design is observed: a direct push is refused and a pull request with a failing boundary check cannot merge, with the refusal message and a protection settings export recorded as evidence (evidence/security-proof/negative-control-6.md).

actions.title: Independent review of WP-001 by a verifier who is not the implementer
actions.acceptance: A fresh-context review of the branch head against the P0.2 design acceptance criteria, recorded on the Work Package. It confirms the registry lists every candidate module of the ARCH-001 capability map, the rules are generated and not hand-written, and the controls were observed failing before passing. Only then may WP-001 move to ACCEPTED, and only the verifier may move it. NOTE (DEC-037, 2026-09-30): the operator has decided the reviewers return a verdict and the operator records ACCEPTED, so the last clause is narrowed for this package; badf/authority.yaml wp_001_acceptance still names the peer reviewer and is the operator's to change.

actions.title: Complete FOUNDATION_SEQUENCE slice S01, the tenant authority, jurisdiction and money-regime input contract
actions.acceptance: One authority profile per initial tenant arrangement, with contract-conclusion authority answered REQUEST_ONLY, DELEGATED_AUTHORITY, MASTER_POLICY_CERTIFICATE, another defined value, or UNKNOWN_BLOCKING. All five review seats record ACCEPT, REVISION_REQUIRED or NOT_APPLICABLE with rationale. This blocks everything downstream and no agent may prepare it beyond assembling the questions.

actions.title: Resolve ADR-001, ADR-004, ADR-005, ADR-010 and ADR-011
actions.acceptance: Each ADR states context, decision, alternatives, consequences, risks, implementation implications and validation requirements, and is recorded ACCEPTED. ADR-001 decides whether the seven dependency rules and one-schema-per-module stand as written; if it narrows or widens them, modules/modules.yaml and the generator are revised in the same package and the boundary suite re-run.

actions.title: Record BT-G0, the architecture contract freeze
actions.acceptance: Slices S01 to S11 accepted in order, every critical finding closed or owned by an explicit expiring risk acceptance, and the BT-G0 result recorded in badf/gates.yaml by the architecture authority. Until this exists no P0 epic may be implemented, which is the single constraint holding this repository at a skeleton.

actions.title: Cut Work Package P0.2-B, the migration layout and lint as a required check
actions.acceptance: The lint runs as a required check on main rather than only in the test suite, and the first tenancy schema is created once P0.6 names its tables. Controls 4, 5, 11 and 12 are re-observed against the required check, verified by the data reviewer and not the implementer.

actions.title: Re-review WP-001 at the revised head, after the issue 8 fixes
actions.acceptance: Three fresh-context reviewers, none the implementer, review the revised head of motor/p0.2/repository-and-boundaries against the P0.2-A criteria and return ACCEPT, posted to issue 8. The operator then records ACCEPTED (DEC-037); no agent does. Run ahead of NS-001 on the operator's instruction. Round nine returned REVISION_REQUIRED from the controls and security reviewers; round ten (PR 10, DEC-039) fixed what it could and the round-ten reviews returned ACCEPT (spec, security) and REVISION_REQUIRED (controls: C10-1, C10-2); round eleven (PR 10, DEC-040) fixed what agents can, so the next re-review was of the round-eleven head; round twelve (the controls review of that head returned REVISION_REQUIRED on R12-2; DEC-041, branch motor/wp001/r12-import-forms, a PR against the Work Package branch) fixed R12-2 and declared R12-1 and R12-3, so the next re-review was of the round-twelve head; round fourteen (the controls review of that head returned REVISION_REQUIRED on R14-1) was fixed in round fifteen (DEC-042, branch motor/biztrust-wp-001/r14-1, a PR against the Work Package branch), so the next re-review was of the round-fifteen head; the round-fifteen reviews returned ACCEPT with minors, and round sixteen (DEC-043, branch motor/biztrust-wp-001/r14-1, PR 14 against the Work Package branch) fixed the agent-fixable ones (security S15-1, CR-1, spec S15-1 and S15-3) and left spec S15-2 and CR-2 to CR-4 open; the round-sixteen reviews (spec, security, code and controls) returned ACCEPT with minors, PR 14 was merged as 64b0811, and round seventeen (DEC-044, branch motor/biztrust-wp-001/r16-1, PR 15 against the Work Package branch) refused every script and pnpmfile a cold pnpm install runs (L1 to L3) and recorded b3a2807 as round sixteen's last code commit (L4), leaving N-1, spec S16-3 and S16-4, security S16-3 and CR16-2 open, so the next re-review is of the round-seventeen head.
